## Sale Smart

::: {.r-fit-text}

Your task is to produce visualizations in Python that show:
For each city:

 - The average house sale price
 - The average estimated monthly rental income
 - How long it will take a property on average to achieve the sale price from rental income for a selected city.

The visualizations should adhere to User Experience best practices including:

- Inclusive & accessible design
- Appropriate use of visualizations

:::

## The Data 

:::{.r-fit-text}

```{python}
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

ss_data = pd.read_csv('Resources/Data/san_berandino_prices.csv')
dupes = ss_data[ss_data.duplicated(['Living Area','Street Name','City','Zip'],keep=False)].sort_values(by=['Living Area','Street Name','City','Zip'])
```

There was some werid duplicates

## The Data 

:::{.r-fit-text}

We also had some `NaN`s too - which we removed.

```{python}
#| echo: false

ss_data = ss_data[~ss_data.duplicated(['Living Area','Street Name','City','Zip'],keep=False)]
ss_data.info()
```

:::

## The average house sale price



```{python}
#| echo: false
sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Price', showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markerfacecolor':'white', 
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'8'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

## The average house sale price

:::{.r-fit-text}

Yoink - there are some expensive properties

And only $1$ at `'Panorama Heights'`.

:::

## The average house sale price

```{python}
#| echo: false

ss_data = ss_data[ss_data['Price'] < 1800000]
ss_data = ss_data[ss_data['City'] != 'Panorama Heights']

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Price', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```

## Visualisation Accessibility 

- no reliance on colour
- appropriate diagram
- acceptable contrast
- alt-text provided


## Estimated monthly rental income

```{python}
#| echo: false

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Rent Estimate', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```


## Time to sale price.


```{python}
#| echo: false

ss_data['Time to even'] = ss_data['Price'] / (ss_data['Rent Estimate'] * 12)

sns.boxplot(data=ss_data, x='City', y='Time to even', color="skyblue",showmeans=True,
            meanprops={'marker':'x',
                       'markeredgecolor':'black',
                       'markersize':'10'})
plt.title('House Prices by City in San Bernardino County')
plt.xlabel('City')
plt.ylabel('Price')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.show()
```


## Time to sale price.

:::{.r-fit-text}

```{python}
#| echo: false

display(ss_data['Time to even'].groupby(ss_data['City']).describe())

```
